article_title: NLog 性能调优：AsyncWrapper 与缓冲日志
core_theme: 用 AsyncWrapper 把日志 I/O 移出调用线程、用 BufferingWrapper 批量写入，配合文件 target 调优与基准测试，打造高吞吐 NLog 配置
reader_takeaway: 读完后能按参数表调优 AsyncWrapper 与 BufferingWrapper，并拿到可直接使用的生产级 NLog 高吞吐配置
summary_angle: 把「同步写入阻塞请求 → 异步队列解耦 → 批量写入提速」的优化弧线压成一张封面：日志从拥堵的单车道变成畅通的队列与批量车队

final_prompt:
Use case: infographic-story
Asset type: wide cover infographic illustration for a Chinese tech blog article
Primary request: Create a wide cinematic infographic-story cover illustration that summarizes the article. Theme: 用异步队列与批量写入优化 NLog 日志性能。The reader should quickly feel 日志写入从阻塞请求变成畅通无阻。

Summary angle: 把「同步写入阻塞 → 异步队列解耦 → 批量写入提速」的优化弧线压成三格连续分镜。
Narrative flow: conflict-to-resolution. In a 2.35:1 frame, keep one dominant focal subject (the middle queue panel) and 2-4 supporting narrative beats.
Information blocks:
- 问题：调用线程被密集的日志信封堵在窄道上，每秒 5000 次同步写争用文件句柄；标签「同步阻塞」+ 数字「5000/秒」
- 机制：日志信封快速滑入带容量刻度的异步队列，调用线程入队即走；标签「异步队列」
- 步骤：后台搬运车把打包好的日志批量送往文件/数据库目标，每批 200 条；标签「批量写入」+ 「200条/批」

Main metaphor: 日志流量从拥堵的单车道改造为「入队即走 + 批量运输」的高效物流通道。
Subject: 一个带容量刻度的日志队列装置，信封形数据包从左侧滑入、右侧批量装车出发。
Composition/framing: 三格连续分镜从左到右递进，中间的队列场景为主焦点并放大，两侧为铺垫与结果；横向叙事，宽幅下保持可读。
Style/medium: combine editorial technical illustration with the selected visual style descriptor: dynamic cinematic storyboard style, sequential panels, camera-motion feeling, strong cuts, clear narrative beats. Stylized, polished, editorial, visually strong, and clearly readable as an infographic-style summary cover. Do not imitate a specific brand, studio, or living artist.
Color palette: 深蓝为主，青绿强调队列通道，暖橙点缀批量搬运，克制使用。
Visible text policy: allow only 1-3 short Chinese labels or number chips by default, and no more than 4 when strictly necessary, all sourced from the information blocks. Each label <= 6 Chinese characters or one required product/model name. No poster title, no long sentences, no English slogans, no fake UI labels, no fake chart axes, no fake architecture node names.
Constraints: no watermark, no prompt residue, no screenshots, no dashboards, no fake diagrams, no fake charts, no fake terminal output, no fabricated metrics, no unrelated icon collage, no decorative clutter.
Avoid: 真实日志文件截图、真实代码界面、仪表盘、无意义代码雨、霓虹高楼背景、漂浮芯片。
